tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// jo bo lugs kyi srung ba'i lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ pañca de wī sā dha naṃ ud+de sha /bod skad du/ lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs mdor bstan pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas khrus byas pa'i mthar lha mo lnga mdor bsdus pa ni/ de la so sor 'brang ma chen mo ni sku mdog ser mo zhal gsum pa/ zhal so so la spyan gsum pa/ phyag bcu pa'o// nag po dang dkar po dag ni/ g.yas dang gcig shos kyi zhal lo// g.yas kyi phyag lnga rnams ni go rim bzhin du/ ral gri dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ mda' dang*/ mchog sbyin dang*/ thugs kar gnas pa la gdugs bsnams pa'o// de bzhin du g.yon gyi phyag lnga rnams na/ gzhu dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ rin po che'i chun po dang*/ dgra s+t+wa dang*/ dung bsnams pa'o// rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan can/ sha 'gag nag po can stod g.yogs dmar pos brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pas 'gying zhing bzhugs pa/ lha'i rgyan dang gos thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// rma bya chen mo ni sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mdzes shing rma bya'i mdongs dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis so// stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma ni/ sngon ma ji lta ba bzhin no// gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin ma ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog nag mo/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis ral gri dang mchog sbyin/ phyag g.yon pa dag gis dgra s+t+wa dang zhags pa'o// bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas pa ral gri dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon pa dgra s+t+wa dang zhags pa'o// yi ge gsum gyis mtshan cing rang gi sa bon gyi dbus su rang gi ming dang bcas pa ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dhā rī badz+ri ṇī ma hā pra ti sā re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ te a mṛ ta ba re ba re bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ a mṛ te bi lo ki ni gar+bha saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi ā kar+ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bi ma le bi pu le dza ya wa re dza ya waṃ ti naṃ a mṛ ta mṛ dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra in+d+rā ya ba la ni sho dha ni ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'di rnams kyi sngags so// lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs mdor bstan pa rdzogs so// ༈ /jo bo lugs kyi srung ba'i lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i tho yig phan bde'i sprin char ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pañca rak+ṣa de wī bh+yaḥ 'dir gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi zhing*/ phan bde'i dpal 'byor rgyas par bya ba'i phyir bsdus pa'i tshul gyis 'phags ma rig pa'i rgyal mo lnga'i rnal 'byor bsgom par 'dod pas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas shing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis yid la byas te/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la sogs skyabs sems ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams dang*/ swa bhā bas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te tshogs gnyis kyi rang 'bras snang stong zung 'jug lha'i skur ldangs pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su ri rab kyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus su pram̐ ser po/ shar du māṃ ljang gu/ lhor hūm̐ dkar po/ nub tu mam̐ nag po/ byang du sham̐ dmar po/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las lha mo lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid so sor 'brang ma sku mdog ser mo/

ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag bcu ma/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na rim pa bzhin/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ thugs kar gdugs bsnams pa'o// g.yon rnams na gzhu/ rgyal mtshan/ rin po che'i chun po/ dgra s+t+wa/ dung bsnams pa/ sha 'gag nag po dang*/ stod g.yogs dmar pos brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pas 'gying zhing bzhugs pa/ lha'i rgyan dang gos thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar du rma bya chen mo sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ phyag g.yas rma bya'i mdongs dang g.yon mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ lhor stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rma bya'i mdongs dang g.yon mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ nub tu gsang sngags rjes 'dzin sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang mchog sbyin phyag rgya/ g.yon gnyis dgra s+t+wa dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ byang du bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon gnyis na dgra s+t+wa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma gtso bor gyur pa'i srung ba'i lha mo lnga oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par thim/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las so sor 'brang ma la rin chen 'byung ldan/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin la mi bskyod pa/ stong chen rab 'joms la rnam snang*/ rma bya chen mo la don grub/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ sngags bzla ba ni/ lha mo so so'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi dhā rī badz+ri ṇī ma hā pra ti sā re

nor bu 'dzin ma rdo rje can ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ so sor 'brang ma'i sngags so// oṃ a mṛ te a mṛ ta ba re ba re bi shud+dhe bdud rtsi bdud rtsi mchog ma mchog ma rnam par dag pa ma/ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ stong chen rab 'joms kyi sngags so// oṃ a mṛ te bi lo ki ni gar+bha saṃ rak+ṣa ṇa ā kar+ṣa ṇi bdud rtsi ma rnam par gzigs ma snying po yang dag par srung ba 'gugs ma/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rma bya chen mo'i sngags so// oṃ bi ma le bi pu le dza ya ba re dza ya ba ti ni a mṛ ta mṛ dza dri med ma yangs pa ma rgyal ba mchog ma rgyal ba can ma 'jam pa'i bdud rtsi ma/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ma'i sngags so// oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra in+d+rā ya bā la bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa le rgyas pa rgyas pa yang dag par rgyas pa yang dag par rgyas pa dbang po'i ched du stobs rnam par sbyong ba sgra sgrog spyod ma/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i sngags so// de ltar sor 'brang ma gtso bor bton pa'i sngags rnams ci nus bzlas/ thun mtshams su/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ de la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca rak+ṣa de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gi byin rlabs rdo rje'i go cha yis// mi mthun tshogs rnams zhi zhing srung ba dang*// phan dang bde ba'i 'byor pa rgyas mdzad ma// rig pa'i rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang mthun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhus la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/

nyer bsdu ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor rnams rang la thim/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ de'ang nā da'i bar du thim zhing nā da'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag de las ldang ba na slar yang rang skad cig gis so sor 'brang ma'i skur gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /srung ba lha lnga 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /bsnyen pa byed na/ gnas dben par 'di nyid kyi bris sku sogs yod na dgram pa'i spyan sngar dang*/ gang ltar yang stegs kyi khar 'bul gtor dkar zlum chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas bsham/ gza' tshes dge ba nas brtsams te thun bzhi'am gsum gyi rim pas rnal 'byor la 'jug bsnyen tshad so 'brang ma'i sngags 'bum phrag bzhi dang*/ gzhan rnams khri phrag bzhi re tsam bzla/ thun gnyis sam snga thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu'i rjes rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal la gnas/ gtor ma oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum rgyas par spro na/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur zhes pa'i tshab tu 'di la zhes bsgyur ba tsam khyad par ro// bsdu na/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas srung ba'i lha mo lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/

gang ltar yang*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ pañca rak+ṣa de wī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul la/ bdag bskyed kyi mjug ltar mchod cing bstod/ rig pa'i rgyal mo 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ yig brgya dang*/ nongs bshags/ rten yod na brten bzhugs/ rten med na mdun bskyed rgyas pa'i tshe ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ spyan drangs pa yin na gshegs gsol rkyang pa bya/ bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// chos srung gi gtor ma 'bul bar spro na/ lha gtor gyi rjes su rgyal chen sde bzhi la gtor bsngo spyi ltar gyis na 'brel chags par 'gyur/ gzhan mtshams kyi spang blang sogs spyi ltar shes par byas la nyams su blang ngo*// rjes gnang byed na/ sbyor ba'i skabs su maṇ+ḍa lar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir zla gdan la lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu re bkod/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor dang*/ rang gi nye logs su bum pa gnyis sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du bya/ dngos gzhi mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed gong ltar dang*/ bum bzlas/ mdun bskyed slob ma'i bya ba/ rjes chog sogs snar thang brgya rtsa'i chings spyi 'gro kho bos byas pa'i jo bo lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa gtso rkyang gi skabs ltar la/ lha'i gdan dang*/ sa bon/ mngon rtogs/ rigs bdag lha sngags mchod bstod/ lha'i mtshan sogs dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos rnams ma 'khrul bar sbyar bas grub bo// zhes pa'ang rang gzhan la nye bar mkho ba'i slad bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos zhu chen ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta tshul khrims rin chen gyi gsung rab ltar ngag 'don bklags chog tu sbyar ba ste/ dge bas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad mi mthun rgud pa'i gdung ba mtha' dag zhi zhing*/

phan bde'i dpal gyi 'byor pa la 'dod rgur rtsen pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
